findings.evidence: of_coact at ComoduleCat.lean:76 and induced_coact both `@[simp]`; `ofSubcomodule` abbrev = `_root_.TauCeti.ComoduleCat.of R C N`.
findings.fix: Delete `ofSubcomodule_coact`; the fact is closed by `simp [of_coact, induced_coact]`.
findings.issue: `ComoduleCat.ofSubcomodule_coact` is a composite of two existing `@[simp]` lemmas and adds nothing: `ComoduleCat.of_coact` (ComoduleCat.lean:76, `coact (of R C N) = coact N`) and `Subcomodule.induced_coact` (this file, `coact (M := N) = N.inducedCoact`) already reduce the goal, since `ofSubcomodule N` unfolds to `of R C N`.

findings.evidence: `abbrev ofSubcomodule N := _root_.TauCeti.ComoduleCat.of R C N`; `abbrev ofSubcomoduleSubtype N := Subcomodule.subtype N`; `subtype_apply` already gives `subtype N n = n`.
findings.fix: Drop the two abbreviations and `ofSubcomoduleSubtype_apply`; use `ComoduleCat.of R C N` and `Subcomodule.subtype N` directly at call sites.
findings.issue: `ofSubcomodule` and `ofSubcomoduleSubtype` are thin renames over `ComoduleCat.of R C N` and `Subcomodule.subtype N`; the accompanying `ofSubcomoduleSubtype_apply` just restates `subtype_apply`.

findings.evidence: `def subtypeLinear : N →ₗ[R] M := N.toSubmodule.subtype` (line 56) vs `toLinearMap := N.toSubmodule.subtype` in `subtype` (line 250).
findings.fix: Either inline `N.toSubmodule.subtype`, or if the abbreviation is kept for readability, use it uniformly (including in `subtype`) and don't export a second public name for the same map.
findings.issue: `subtypeLinear` is a public `@[expose] def` duplicating `N.toSubmodule.subtype` (Mathlib `Submodule.subtype`); it is even used inconsistently, since the `subtype` comodule Hom (line 250) builds directly from `N.toSubmodule.subtype`.

summary: The induced-comodule core is genuinely new and reuses Mathlib flatness/codRestrict API well. Duplication is limited to the ComoduleCat wrapper layer: a redundant composite simp lemma and thin abbreviations over existing spellings.
